import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 10;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int[][] a = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];

    static int add(int a, int b) {
        a += b;
        return a >= MOD ? a - MOD : a;
    }

    static int sub(int a, int b) {
        a -= b;
        return a < 0 ? a + MOD : a;
    }

    static int mul(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((a * 1L * b) % MOD);
    }

    static int power(int a, int n) {
        if (n == 0)
            return 1;
        int b = power(a, n / 2);
        b = mul(b, b);
        return (n & 1) == 1 ? mul(b, a) : b;
    }

    static int rev(int a) {
        return power(a, MOD - 2);
    }

    static int divv(int a, int b) {
        return mul(a, rev(b));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                a[i][j] = divv(a[i][j], 100);
            }
        }

        List<Pair<List<Integer>, Integer>> sets = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Pair<List<Integer>, Integer>> newSets = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> newSet = new ArrayList<>();
        sets.add(new Pair<>(Arrays.asList(0), 1));

        for (int g = 0; g < n; g++) {
            newSets.clear();
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
                int value = 1;
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (((mask >> j) & 1) != 0)
                        value = mul(value, a[j][g]);
                    else
                        value = mul(value, sub(1, a[j][g]));
                }
                for (Pair<List<Integer>, Integer> np : sets) {
                    List<Integer> baseSet = np.first;
                    int baseVal = np.second;
                    List<Integer> tempSet = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int mask2 : baseSet) {
                        int possible = (~mask2) & mask;
                        while (possible != 0) {
                            int pos = possible & (-possible);
                            tempSet.add(mask2 | pos);
                            possible ^= pos;
                        }
                    }
                    if (tempSet.isEmpty())
                        continue;
                    Collections.sort(tempSet);
                    // Remove duplicates
                    List<Integer> uniqueSet = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < tempSet.size(); i2++) {
                        if (i2 == 0 || tempSet.get(i2) != tempSet.get(i2 - 1))
                            uniqueSet.add(tempSet.get(i2));
                    }
                    newSets.add(new Pair<>(uniqueSet, mul(baseVal, value)));
                }
            }
            Collections.sort(newSets, (p1, p2) -> {
                int size1 = p1.first.size();
                int size2 = p2.first.size();
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < Math.min(size1, size2); i2++) {
                    int cmp = Integer.compare(p1.first.get(i2), p2.first.get(i2));
                    if (cmp != 0)
                        return cmp;
                }
                return Integer.compare(size1, size2);
            });
            sets.clear();
            int i = 0;
            while (i < newSets.size()) {
                int j = i;
                int sumVal = 0;
                while (j < newSets.size() && newSets.get(j).first.equals(newSets.get(i).first)) {
                    sumVal = add(sumVal, newSets.get(j).second);
                    j++;
                }
                sets.add(new Pair<>(newSets.get(i).first, sumVal));
                i = j;
            }
        }

        int res = 0;
        for (Pair<List<Integer>, Integer> np : sets) {
            res = add(res, np.second);
        }
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    static class Pair<F, S> {
        F first;
        S second;

        Pair(F f, S s) {
            first = f;
            second = s;
        }
    }
}
